description: Save or update a workspace postcard rule with matching sender/recipient email, subject contains/exact, US return/delivery addresses, attachment or generated front preference, optional image style instructions, and email-body or custom message. removeImagePrompt defaults true: omit recognizable image-request sentences or labeled prompt blocks from email-derived printed text, while retaining the original body for artwork. False retains them; custom messages and explicit preview/quote message edits are unchanged. postcardType selects single_sided (default for new rules) or double_sided; existing rules without the field retain double_sided. The sender field plus optional additionalSenders (up to 19 exact email addresses) form an OR list. Any listed sender can match; recipient and subject conditions still apply with AND. Matching trims whitespace and ignores capitalization. Existing single-sender and recipient-only rules keep their behavior. Editing the sender list requires renewed autosend consent. All conditions must match; first enabled match wins. Choose mode:approval (default) or mode:auto. Saving any rule requires production workspace authentication and OAuth mcp:read/mcp:write/mcp:send. For artwork:generate in either mode, obtain permission to share up to the first 1200 characters of verified matching emails and saved style instructions with the image service during inbox processing. Approval mode prepares artwork before review without mailing. For auto, obtain explicit recurring authorization for prepaid-credit spending within shared sending limits and terms, then pass consent:true; generated artwork also requires authorization to share matching email text and style instructions with the image service. Consent is required again when updating an automatic rule. At most 25 rules. Saving does not itself send mail, but future verified matching emails may generate artwork, spend credits and mail automatically. Unverified signatures, insufficient credits, exceeded limits and changed rules wait for approval. No automatic card funding.

additionalSenders.description: Additional exact sender emails, matched with OR against sender. Up to 19; recipient and subject conditions still apply.

removeImagePrompt.description: Remove recognizable image-generation instructions from email-derived printed text. Defaults to true. False retains them. The original email still guides artwork; custom messages and explicit preview/quote message edits are unchanged. Start previews from get_email_postcard.suggestedMessage.

name: save_email_postcard_rule

outputSchema.description: Read operation first for financial/mail state and recovery. Optional service fields are absent on failure. Unknown is not zero or permission to retry. Legacy service fields remain available.

amountCents.description: USD cents. Null means not applicable or not known; never interpret null as zero.
